Bill Gates, the truth about vaccines, and Big Pharma's treatment of dissenting doctors fill this Tucker Carlson episode. Carlson delivers a sweeping indictment of the vaccine establishment and its richest champion. The jab debate gets his full argument in one bitter hour.

Carlson questions the safety story told about the COVID shots and the data behind it. He argues that doctors who raised doubts were punished to scare others silent. Gates's funding of health bodies worldwide sits at the center of his case. Skeptical and questioning viewers get the host's complete brief against the system.
